description: Put a period at the end of the sentence. Stop allowing everything to occupy mental space. #selflove #selfleadership #moveon
transcript: In everything I do, I land the plane. I put a period after every sentence. I do not allow things to linger. If I need to come back to it, I will. But every moment, every experience, every step, I allow that to be. I don't ruminate on anything. Allow anything to occupy too much space in my brain. I move on and I move forward.
